summary: Pro tier deep decompilation, liquidity drain stress-testing, and privileged access audit for Tether USD (USDT).

findings.title: Centralized Blacklist & Zero-Return Token Transfer Trap
findings.description: Non-standard ERC20 implementation omitting boolean return on transfer(), alongside centralized destroyBlackFunds().

attackSurface.category: Centralized Privilege Escalation & Arbitrary Asset Freeze
attackSurface.attackVector: Smart contract calling IERC20(usdt).transfer() fails silently or reverts in safeTransfer wrappers unless SafeERC20 is used.

remediation.recommendedAction: Apply verified check-effects-interactions, enforce timelocks, and guard critical state variables.
